translations.zh: 孟德，濟南人。
translations.literal: Meng De was a native of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Meng De was from Jinan.

translations.zh: 國初由鄒平縣令、淄州節度使累官至同知濟南路事。
translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty, through posts as magistrate of Zouping County and military commissioner of Zizhou he rose in succession to associate administrator of Jinan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding he rose through posts as magistrate of Zouping County and military commissioner of Zizhou to become associate administrator of Jinan Circuit.

translations.zh: 太宗即位之八年，諸王闊端命德為元帥，佩金符，領濟南軍攻宋徐州、光州，降其眾而有其地。
translations.literal: In the eighth year after Taizong's accession, Prince Kuoduan appointed De marshal, granted him the gold tally, and had him lead the Jinan army to attack the Song prefectures of Xuzhou and Guangzhou; he reduced their forces and took their territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year after Taizong's accession, Prince Kuoduan made De marshal, granted him the gold tally, and had him lead the Jinan army against the Song prefectures of Xuzhou and Guangzhou, reducing their forces and taking their territory.

translations.zh: 歲甲辰，定宗母六皇后稱制，大王按只台以德為萬戶，攻濠、蘄、黃等州，積有戰功。
translations.literal: In the jiachen year, when Dingzong's mother the Sixth Empress Dowager held the regency, Prince Anjitai made De a ten-thousand-household commander and attacked the prefectures of Hao, Qi, and Huang, accumulating repeated battle achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In jiachen, when Dingzong's mother the Sixth Empress Dowager held the regency, Prince Anjitai made De a ten-thousand-household commander and attacked Hao, Qi, Huang, and other prefectures, winning repeated victories.

translations.zh: 憲宗即位之三年，命德守睢州。
translations.literal: In the third year after Xianzong's accession, De was ordered to defend Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year after Xianzong's accession he was ordered to defend Suizhou.

translations.zh: 五年，移守海州。
translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to defend Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to defend Haizhou.

translations.zh: 宋安撫呂文德以兵擾邊，德敗之，俘其太尉劉海。
translations.literal: Song pacification commissioner Lü Wende harassed the border with troops; De defeated him and captured his Grand Marshal Liu Hai.
translations.idiomatic: When Song pacification commissioner Lü Wende harassed the border, De defeated him and captured his Grand Marshal Liu Hai.

translations.zh: 丁巳，從伯顏攻襄樊。
translations.literal: On the dingsi day he followed Bayan in attacking Xiangyang and Fancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he followed Bayan in the attack on Xiangyang and Fancheng.

translations.zh: 己未，與子義從世祖攻鄂州，先登。
translations.literal: On the jiwei day he and his son Yi followed Shizu in attacking Ezhou and were first to ascend the walls.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he and his son Yi followed Shizu in the assault on Ezhou and were first over the walls.

translations.zh: 中統三年，從征李璮。
translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong he joined the campaign against Li Tan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhongtong he took part in the campaign against Li Tan.

translations.zh: 璮平，德以老告歸。
translations.literal: When Li Tan was pacified, De retired on grounds of age and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: After Li Tan was pacified, De retired on grounds of age and returned home.

translations.zh: 義襲為萬戶，領兵守沂、郯。
translations.literal: Yi inherited as ten-thousand-household commander and led troops to garrison Yi and Tan.
translations.idiomatic: Yi succeeded as ten-thousand-household commander and garrisoned Yi and Tan with his troops.

translations.zh: 四年，賜虎符。
translations.literal: In the fourth year he was granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he received a tiger tally.

translations.zh: 至元元年，城郯。
translations.literal: In the first year of Zhiyuan he fortified Tan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiyuan he fortified Tan.

translations.zh: 六年，從山東統軍帖赤如五河，宋軍拒南岸，義率兵渡河擊之，凡數戰有功。
translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Shandong commander Tiechi to Wuhe; the Song army held the south bank, and Yi led troops across the river to attack them, winning merit in several battles.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Shandong commander Tiechi to Wuhe. The Song army held the south bank, and Yi led his men across the river to attack them, distinguishing himself in several engagements.

translations.zh: 九年，授懷遠大將軍，遷宿州萬戶。
translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed General Who Cherishes the Distant and transferred to ten-thousand-household of Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made cherishing-the-distant general and transferred to the Suzhou ten-thousand-household command.

translations.zh: 十一年，宋制置夏貴攻正陽，義奪戰艦數艘，遂敗之。
translations.literal: In the eleventh year Song commissioner-in-chief Xia Gui attacked Zhengyang; Yi captured several warships and then defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Song commissioner-in-chief Xia Gui attacked Zhengyang. Yi captured several warships and routed him.

translations.zh: 十二年，掠地至安慶等處，攻揚子橋獲功。
translations.literal: In the twelfth year he raided as far as Anqing and other places and won merit in the attack on Yangzi Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he raided as far as Anqing and other places and distinguished himself in the attack on Yangzi Bridge.

translations.zh: 十三年三月，改守杭州。
translations.literal: In the third month of the thirteenth year he was transferred to garrison Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirteenth year he was transferred to garrison Hangzhou.

translations.zh: 九月，從下福建、溫、台等處。
translations.literal: In the ninth month he followed in reducing Fujian, Wenzhou, Taizhou, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he took part in reducing Fujian, Wenzhou, Taizhou, and other places.

translations.zh: 十四年四月，授昭勇大將軍、瑞州路達魯花赤。
translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year he was appointed General of Manifest Courage and Ruizhou Circuit darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year he was made manifest-courage general and darughachi of Ruizhou Circuit.

translations.zh: 十月，徙鎮閩州。
translations.literal: In the tenth month he was transferred to garrison Minzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was transferred to garrison Minzhou.

translations.zh: 十六年，授昭勇大將軍、招討使。
translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was appointed General of Manifest Courage and pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was made manifest-courage general and pacification commissioner.

translations.zh: 二十二年，復為沂郯萬戶。
translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he again became ten-thousand-household of Yi and Tan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he again became ten-thousand-household of Yi and Tan.

translations.zh: 元貞元年，以老辭職。
translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen he resigned on grounds of age.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanzhen he resigned on grounds of age.
